subject: Penetration test executive summary release — embargo logistics & evidence access
messages:
From: Kevin Sullivan <kevin.sullivan@acmeinc.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.example
Cc: Jill Park <jill.park@acmeinc.com>, security@acmeinc.com
Date: 2026-08-19T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: PT exec summary + evidence access + NDA redaction questions

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for running the engagement with our team. Our InfoSec review is wrapping up and we need a short executive summary of the penetration test to share with our board and procurement. We understand full report sharing may require additional legal controls. Two quick asks:  

1) Can you provide a redacted executive summary (1–2 pages) we can circulate?
2) For our SOC 2 attestation and internal audit, our security team will need timeboxed access to evidence (screenshots, logs) and a mapping of any redactions you apply.

We have a standard vendor NDA in place but will likely need a short addendum (embargo and limited distribution clause). Can you confirm your process and suggested timeline?

Appreciate a short reply with next steps so procurement can coordinate paperwork.

—Kevin
Kevin Sullivan
Senior Security Manager, Acme Inc
kevin.sullivan@acmeinc.com
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.example
To: Kevin Sullivan <kevin.sullivan@acmeinc.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.example, laura_bennett@redwood.example, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example, rachel_kim@redwood.example
Date: 2026-08-19T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT exec summary + evidence access + NDA redaction questions

Kevin —

Thanks for the note and the clear asks. Short answer: yes, we can provide a redacted executive summary and controlled, time-limited evidence access. Proposed approach:  

- Exec summary: a 1–2 page PDF (high-level findings, severity summary, remediation status) with sensitive artifacts redacted. We’ll watermark and version it (RDW_PenTest_ExecSum_v1.pdf).
- Evidence access: secure viewer link for a 14-day window for up to 3 named reviewers (view-only, no downloads). We’ll include a redaction map (CSV) that lists what sections were redacted and why.
- NDA addendum: we prefer a short addendum that adds an embargo (14 days) and restricts forwarding. Our legal team (cc’d: laura_bennett) will propose language; procurement can sign via DocuSign.

Timeline: internal security/engineering review and redaction by EOD tomorrow (Aug 20). If that works we can share the exec summary + evidence instructions and DocuSign link the morning of Aug 20, and open the secure viewer once the addendum is signed.

If Acme needs a longer embargo or a different reviewer list, let us know now so we can adjust.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.example
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.example, Kevin Sullivan <kevin.sullivan@acmeinc.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example
Date: 2026-08-19T18:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT exec summary + evidence access + NDA redaction questions

On Thu, Aug 19, 2026 at 5:03 PM Priya Natarajan wrote:
> Timeline: internal security/engineering review and redaction by EOD tomorrow (Aug 20).

Kevin — quick technical notes on evidence scope so expectations match:  

- We will NOT provide raw packet captures or unredacted backend logs.
- We can provide sanitized request/response traces and screenshot artifacts that demonstrate exploit reproduction, with IPs/user identifiers redacted.
- The evidence CSV will reference specific finding IDs from the full report and a short rationale for each redaction.
- For the secure viewer, we will enable session logging (who viewed, timestamps) and disable copy/paste.

If Acme’s SOC 2 auditor requires additional artifacts, please share the auditor contact — we can discuss a limited escrow path or in-person review under supervision.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Staff Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.example
To: Jill Park <jill.park@acmeinc.com>, Kevin Sullivan <kevin.sullivan@acmeinc.com>, priya_natarajan@redwood.example
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example
Date: 2026-08-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT exec summary + evidence access + NDA redaction questions

Hi Jill/Kevin —

We’ve drafted a short NDA addendum that:  

1) Confirms an embargo period of 14 days from delivery of the exec summary;  
2) Restricts distribution to the three named reviewers and Acme’s SOC 2 auditor (if auditor contact is provided);  
3) Prohibits storage of evidence artifacts outside Acme’s approved S3 buckets and requires secure-viewer-only access unless escrow is agreed;  
4) Requires destruction certification after access window expires.

I’ve attached the DocuSign envelope (link) and included a redaction justification matrix in RDW_PenTest_FullReport_summary_redaction_map.csv. We’re flexible on minor wording but would like signature prior to turning on viewer access.

Attachment: Evidence_Share_Instructions.docx (access steps + reviewer list template)

If acceptable, Priya will send the exec sum and link once signed.

—Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Kevin Sullivan <kevin.sullivan@acmeinc.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.example, priya_natarajan@redwood.example
Cc: Jill Park <jill.park@acmeinc.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.example
Date: 2026-08-20T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PT exec summary + evidence access + NDA redaction questions

Laura/Priya —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear plan. Procurement has reviewed the addendum; the 14-day embargo and reviewer limit are fine. Two quick follow-ups before we sign:  

1) Can the secure viewer window be extended to 21 days if our lead auditor needs extra time? We can request extension in writing; would Redwood approve one ad-hoc 7-day extension?
2) Please include the name and contact for the person at Redwood who will perform the session logging if we need an auditor attestation.

If those two items are OK, Jill will sign the DocuSign and we’ll provide auditor contact details. Looking forward to the exec sum.

—Kevin
Kevin Sullivan
Senior Security Manager, Acme Inc
